Black—Victini and Reshiram |enva=[[David Brimmer|Michael Alston Baley]] |java=[[Kōichi Yamadera]] }} '''Mannes''' (Japanese: '''モーモント''' ''Momont'') is a major character who appeared in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. He is the mayor of [[Eindoak Town]] and a descendant of the People of the Vale. Mannes also owns and operates a farm estate in town. ==In the movies== Mannes first appeared during the [[Eindoak Harvest Festival]] battle tournament, announcing the tournament's rules and officially kicking off the tournament with a speech and musical performance thanks to his Pokémon-operated instrument. Later, he revealed that he is a descendant of the People of the Vale, and taught {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} the history of Eindoak Town, and the history of the [[Kingdom of the Vale]] and how it all connects to {{OBP|Victini|M14}}. Ash and his friends enjoy their time on Mannes' farm estate, where they watch Victini and their Pokémon play with the other wild Pokémon. He, along with the other descendants, agreed to allow [[Damon]] to move the [[Sword of the Vale]] in the hope of restoring the ancient kingdom to its former glory. Mannes had been supporting Damon's efforts in locating the other descendants from other parts of the world, and was a big advocate of the plan. Once the Sword began its journey, Mannes followed after it in his {{p|Klinklang}}-powered helicopter and realized the [[Dragon Force]] has been disturbed and was destroying the landscape. He goes to the Sword of the Vale as it's flying through the sky and informs everyone of the turn of events and then helps [[Juanita]], [[Carlita]], Cilan, and Iris evacuate the castle and tries to stop Damon after realizing the unintended and destructive consequences of the plan to resurrect the ancient kingdom. After the Sword of the Vale was relocated, Mannes helped the other descendants in rebuilding and replenishing the Kingdom of the Vale and landscape. ===Character=== Mannes is a jovial and light-hearted individual that can easily bring people together.
